matrix_status_changes.collection_insert_explicit_id: WAL-supported for JSON, BSON, and template-v1 stored documents through normal collection executor
matrix_status_changes.collection_delete_explicit_id: WAL-supported; missing IDs are idempotent no-ops and replay advances AppliedCommandLSN

crash_recovery_scenarios: unapplied CollectionInsertBatchByID frame replays after reopen and advances AppliedCommandLSN
unapplied CollectionInsertBatchByID frame replays template-v1 stored documents without callback/resolver nondeterminism
unapplied CollectionDeleteBatchByID frame deletes existing IDs, ignores missing IDs, and advances AppliedCommandLSN
missing-only CollectionDeleteBatchByID frame publishes a no-op AppliedCommandLSN advancement
normal_path_scenarios: public InsertBatch appends one command frame and publishes roots with AppliedCommandLSN=1
catalog CreateCollection returns ErrCommandWALUnsupported while command_wal_v1 is active
runtime_assertions: ordered-root publish appends command WAL before root visibility and advances AppliedCommandLSN in the same finalize boundary
post-append finalize failure poisons the handle before commit serialization is released
collection command replay installs a temporary recovery snapshot view before invoking normal collection executors

performance_gate.rationale: The recorded PR4 local microbenchmark artifact is retained as historical evidence, but it is no longer accepted as a passing performance gate under the final strict parity-plus policy. Required command-WAL throughput lanes must be strictly greater than 1.01x of the WAL-off baseline; these recorded PR4 lanes are sub-parity and therefore fail the gate.

summary.insert_unindexed_command_wal_docs_per_se: 873k docs/s median-ish benchstat row; baseline WAL-off 1.205M docs/s
summary.allocation_note: payload encoders avoid per-document clone allocation before frame copy; command mode still records expected extra frame payload and publish bookkeeping allocations

unsupported_modes: catalog create/update/drop commands remain WAL-rejected until PR6
query-wide collection mutations remain outside PR4
legacy raw WAL payloads remain unsupported in command_wal_v1 directories

cleanup_debt.notes: PR4 collection command payloads embed explicit IDs and stored document bytes; no external refs are introduced.
